options.content:
Operate the SuperPOD
Command Center
Prioritized fleet decisions and Super Unit roll-up
Live Topology
Fleet → rack → tray → four GPUs in one visual surface
Infrastructure
Agent, CPU, memory, filesystem, pressure and sensor worklists
GPU & NVLink
Fleet GPU health, load, power, thermals and NVLink readiness
Fabric, CVT & Cabling
Host HCAs, switch inventory and fabric coverage truth
Workloads, Slurm & Validation
Live and range job inventory, placement and efficiency
AI Performance & Inference SLO
Overall GPU utilisation plus inference/SLO coverage truth
Head Node & BCM Control Plane
Head-node load, storage, CMDaemon, cmsh cost, sockets and control-plane logs
Investigate an exact entity
Tray Root Cause
Selected tray OS, storage, GPUs, HCAs, jobs and logs
GPU Root Cause
Selected GPU identity, XID, ECC, PCIe and NVLink evidence
HCA / Port Root Cause
Selected HCA state, traffic, counters, job impact and driver logs
Switch Root Cause
Selected switch reachability, firmware and rack blast radius
Job Flight Recorder
One job across placement, GPU, host, HCA and runtime evidence
Workload Expected Fabric Path
Job → DGX → HCA → expected leaf and spine design intent
Platform, Storage & Telemetry
VictoriaMetrics, Loki, lake durability and head-node gap
Specialist evidence
Accelerator Reliability
Violation counters, throttle, memory and PCIe reliability
NVLink & NVSwitch Fabric
Per-lane NVLink, IMEX, registration and NVSwitch state
Ethernet & Host Network
Host NIC carrier, errors, drops, softnet and TCP reliability
Host Reliability & Inventory
Filesystem, disk, EDAC, pressure, OS and hardware inventory
Thermal & Power
Every hwmon sensor, alarm, thermal zone and power meter
Logs & Events
Fleet-wide GPU, kernel, network, scheduler and platform logs
NCCL Validation
Rack verdicts, acceptance bandwidth, run history and missing coverage
Every dashboard returns here through the persistent HOME link. Expected topology and unavailable telemetry are explicitly labelled; no missing publisher is rendered healthy.
